label: concurrency smoke: does the gather path actually overlap sessions?
why: Two launches proved the config flag alone does nothing: our loop awaited one task at a time, so the evaluator never had a second task to overlap and wall clock equalled the sum of task durations. The cell now gathers the same per-task coroutines the harness gathers. Six tasks, three at a time, V5 archive: expect 3/6 (6644 T, 3934 F, 14851 T, 3718 T, 14266 F, 14487 F) and a wall clock near one third of the sum. Any flip on these six is a warning that batching changes outcomes.
